headline: Every model on the shared shelf now has a known front
lede: The arcade's shared 3D model library (#637) could prove a model's size but never its facing. #901 closed that: every model declares forward = +Z / up = +Y, the ones with a real front are proven by geometry, and the kit grew from 27 to 45 pieces.

notes.text: Facing law live: every shelf model declares radial / +Z / rigged; a front facing backwards (−Z) is now a build error the checker refuses.
Village & fantasy kit added — cottage, watchtower, windmill, well, campfire, statue, crates, barrels, benches, lamp posts, bridges, bushes, toadstools — plus a market cart. All CC0, all ≤400 tris.
shelfcheck 189 → 354 checks green, with the facing gate proven red once (a flipped cottage door) so it actually bites.
